findings.message: This HTML file has 6 timed elements. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div id="day"> is a timeline element that contains nested <section>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="day"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
